name: The Duck Company
old_description: WE BELIEVE EVERY PERSON IS AN ADVENTURER & EVERY ADVENTURE DESERVES TO BE CELEBRATED
about:
The Duck Company operates from Arvada, Colorado, where it was founded in 1988. The business began with its founders printing shirts in a barn, a humble start that the company still references as central to its identity. No founder names are disclosed in public materials.

The company produces adventure-themed apparel, including officially licensed Volkswagen collections and numerous national park lines. Its product range centers on graphic shirts and related soft goods designed to celebrate outdoor experiences. Facility size, headcount, and annual volumes are not publicly specified.

The brand serves individual adventurers and retail partners, with a stated emphasis on helping small businesses. Its licensed VW and national park collections suggest distribution through specialty outdoor and automotive enthusiast channels, though specific customer names are not provided.

The company says it was built on the belief that every person is an adventurer and every adventure deserves to be celebrated. That mission, articulated since its barn-based beginnings, remains the stated reason for its existence.
